r17b-001.gate_key: ind_polite | B1.2 | mcq | Choose the correct option: Could you tell me when ___ ? The guarantee may still be valid. | you bought this laptop

item.q: Choose the correct option: Could you tell me when ___ ? The guarantee may still be valid.
item.why: *When did you buy this laptop?* becomes *when you bought this laptop*: no *did*, and the verb itself is in the past. With *when* (a finished time) we do not use the present perfect.
item.why_lv: *When did you buy this laptop?* kļūst par *when you bought this laptop*: bez *did*, un pagātnē ir pats darbības vārds. Ar *when* (pabeigts laiks) Present Perfect nelieto.

r17b-002.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | write | Your team wants to launch the new app next month, but the tests are not finished, and a delay will cost money. Write a sentence that starts with *The question is whether*, *The question is how* or *The question is why*. |

key.model: The question is whether we can afford the delay.
must: *Questions is* does not agree: one question, so *The question is*.
After *The question is* put *whether*, *how*, *why* or another question word.
After *how*, *why* or *whether* use statement word order: *how we can…*, not *how can we…*.

item.q: Your team wants to launch the new app next month, but the tests are not finished, and a delay will cost money. Write a sentence that starts with *The question is whether*, *The question is how* or *The question is why*.
must: *Questions is* does not agree: one question, so *The question is*.
*Questions is* nesaskan: viens jautājums, tāpēc *The question is*.
After *The question is* put *whether*, *how*, *why* or another question word.
Aiz *The question is* liec *whether*, *how*, *why* vai citu jautājuma vārdu.
After *how*, *why* or *whether* use statement word order: *how we can…*, not *how can we…*.
Aiz *how*, *why* vai *whether* lieto stāstījuma vārdu secību: *how we can…*, nevis *how can we…*.
item.model: The question is whether we can afford the delay.
item.why: Compare your sentence with the model answer.

r17b-003.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.2 | mcq | Choose the correct option: It was a difficult task, and ___ they finished it on time. | yet

item.q: Choose the correct option: It was a difficult task, and ___ they finished it on time.
item.why: *and yet* = but, in spite of this: *and yet they finished it on time*. *although* starts a part that needs another main clause; *despite* and *in spite of* go before a noun or an *-ing* form, not before *they finished*.
item.why_lv: *and yet* = bet tomēr: *and yet they finished it on time*. Teikums ar *although* nav pabeigts bez vēl vienas daļas; *despite* un *in spite of* lieto pirms lietvārda vai *-ing* formas, nevis pirms *they finished*.

r17b-004.gate_key: ind_polite | B1.2 | gap | I'm not sure ___ ___ ___ ___ the tickets yet. Let me check my email. |

item.q: I'm not sure ___ ___ ___ ___ the tickets yet. Let me check my email.
item.why: A yes/no question after *I'm not sure*: *if* + subject + verb: *if we have booked*, not *if have we booked*.
item.why_lv: Jautājums ar atbildi jā / nē pēc *I'm not sure*: *if* + teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds: *if we have booked*, nevis *if have we booked*.
